editor.emptyTitle: Where would you like to start?

editor.selectHint: Select a node or relation in the graph to explore its details.
editor.confirmRemoveLevels: Deleting {{name}} permanently removes this model level, its contents and any dependent model levels.
editor.coloursHint:
Colours apply to each base type and its refinements.
Changes appear immediately.

editor.modelChanged: The active model level has changed. Please start the action again.
editor.chooseRelationHint: Choose what the new relationship represents.
editor.noRelation: No relationship is permitted between these nodes in this direction.
editor.confirmRemoveConnection: Remove {{name}} from {{from}} to {{to}}? Any relationships that refine it will also be removed.
editor.connectHint:
Select a source and target or drag a relationship.
Double-click for a self-relationship.
editor.eraseHint: Click the node or relationship you want to remove.
editor.connectionSourceHint: {{name}} is selected. Choose the target node.
editor.projectNameLength: Choose a descriptive project name with 3–70 characters.

editor.relationExists: This relationship already exists between the selected nodes.
editor.baseNodeConnected: This base node is used by relationships. Remove the relationships first to remove it from the canvas.
editor.nodeUnavailable: This node is no longer available.

editor.annotationTypesHint: Define the annotation types used on this model level, such as p or note.
